name: Evidence Decision Assistant
shortDescription: Turns supplied evidence into a traceable decision memo with explicit uncertainty and next actions.
businessUseCase: Teams lose decision quality when sources, assumptions, constraints, and unresolved questions are mixed together.

listing.problem: Teams lose decision quality when sources, assumptions, constraints, and unresolved questions are mixed together.
workflow: Separate sourced facts from assumptions and gaps
Draft a reversible recommendation and next evidence requests

exampleUses.title: Compare vendors with incomplete evidence
exampleUses.scenario: A team must shortlist vendors while security, migration, and pricing evidence is incomplete.
exampleUses.exampleRequest: Compare these vendors against our constraints and identify what evidence to request next.
exampleUses.expectedOutcome: A traceable comparison matrix, explicit uncertainty, and a reversible recommendation.

exampleUses.title: Turn research notes into a decision memo
exampleUses.scenario: An owner has mixed notes and needs a concise artifact without losing the evidence trail.
exampleUses.exampleRequest: Convert these notes into a decision memo that labels evidence, inference, risk, and next actions.
exampleUses.expectedOutcome: A concise memo whose claims are tied to supplied evidence and clearly labeled assumptions.

successCriteria: Every conclusion distinguishes evidence from inference
Missing evidence and uncertainty are explicit
The recommendation is linked to stated constraints
limitations: Cannot verify sources that were not supplied or fetched through an enabled cited skill
Does not make legal, medical, or investment decisions
